assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: Data-dependent MS/MS spectra were acquired in the ion trap using CID
labeling: high-resolution mass spectrometry-based label-free protein quantitation was performed
quantification: Spectra acquired from biological triplicate were loaded (Thermo raw files) into the Progenesis QI for Proteomics software (version 1.05156.29278) for label-free protein quantitation.
enrichment: GPR110 and its interacting partners linked by DSS were pulled down by immunoprecipitation with HA antibody.
Affinity purification (AP) and mass spectrometry has emerged as an important tool for probing protein-protein interactions
workflow_hints: chemical crosslinking, affinity purification, and quantitative mass spectrometry

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a chemical crosslinking (DSS) and affinity purification (AP-MS) approach to identify interacting partners of GPR110. While the results discuss occludin phosphorylation (Y285), this was analyzed via Western Blot, not the MS proteomics workflow itself. The MS search parameters included a specific end-capping modification.

organism: MS/MS data were searched against the NCBInr human database
C57BL/6 mice were obtained from NIH-NCI animal facility
cell_lines: HEK293 cells (ATCC, CRL-1573) and GloResponse™ CRE-luc2P HEK293 cells (Promega, E8500) were maintained
scope: GPR110 and its interacting partners linked by DSS were pulled down by immunoprecipitation with HA antibody. The co-immunoprecipitates were separated by SDS-PAGE, digested with trypsin, and analyzed by LC/MS/MS
Chemical crosslinking combined with affinity purification (AP) and mass spectrometry has emerged as an important tool for probing protein-protein interactions

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: While the study uses mouse models for BBB permeability and phosphorylation assays, the mass spectrometry proteomics was specifically performed on HA-tagged human GPR110 expressed in HEK293 cells using affinity purification (immunoprecipitation). PRIDE metadata mentions kidney and embryonic cells, but the text explicitly describes the MS material as immunopurified complexes from HEK293 cells.
